description: Historical-baseline contract for the paired HTTP/1.1 TLS POST/echo throughput check (issue #5505). One runner builds the pinned reference revision and the candidate revision with the same toolchain and ci-release profile, then measures them in interleaved rounds against the same proto_backend/proto_bench harness. The gate is the paired candidate/reference throughput ratio, which cancels runner CPU class and absolute-RPS drift; absolute RPS is recorded but never gated. Raise min_ratio toward 1.0 as the gap closes; never lower it or change the workload to make a production regression disappear.
